items.q: What's the difference between a facial and skin quality treatment?
items.a: A facial is a one-off treatment that fades within days. Skin quality care at Lunia starts with a real diagnostic read of your skin, then builds a sustained plan session by session, so results compound instead of fading. That's our positioning: not facials, skin quality.

No, every protocol at Lunia is non-injectable. We use diagnostic-led, clinical-grade topical and device-based treatments (LED therapy, microdermabrasion, lymphatic drainage, and more) to build lasting skin, hair & scalp, and post-surgery recovery quality without needles.

items.q: What does "Korean-inspired" mean for your approach?
items.a: Our philosophy borrows from the Korean skincare tradition of diagnostic-first, layered, long-term skin quality, rather than chasing a quick fix. Every visit begins with analysis, not a treatment menu.

hero.heading: Skin quality is our whole philosophy
hero.intro: We didn't set out to build another spa. Lunia exists because Riyadh needed a place that treats skin, hair, and recovery with the seriousness of a real diagnosis, not a menu of quick fixes.

story.heading: Why we started Lunia
paragraphs: Lunia began with a simple frustration: too many facials, too few real results. Customers would leave glowing for a weekend and be back where they started within a week, because nothing about the treatment was calibrated to what their skin actually needed.

We looked instead to the Korean approach to skin care, where diagnosis comes before treatment and consistency matters more than any single session. That became our founding idea: read the skin first, personalize everything after, and measure quality over months, not days.

Today Lunia is three departments working from the same philosophy, Skin Quality, Hair & Scalp, and Post-Surgery Recovery, each diagnostic-led, each built to sustain a result rather than chase a moment.

positioning.heading: A facial is a moment. Skin quality is a practice.
positioning.body: A facial can make skin glow for a weekend. Skin quality is what holds after that, built through an accurate diagnosis, a personalized plan, and a rhythm of visits that compounds instead of resetting. That distinction shapes every protocol at Lunia, across skin, hair and scalp, and post-surgery recovery.
